g.text: Column names follow Flyway V45. PostgreSQL 16.
The parent primary key must exist (FK NOT NULL)
The child may be recorded without a parent when the FK is nullable
The FK cannot be changed to a primary key that does not exist
A primary-key change is copied to every child foreign key
PostgreSQL's default when no ON DELETE action is declared
Deleting the parent deletes the child rows
Deleting the parent sets the child foreign key to NULL
The canonical link is `procedures.fk_id_budget`. `budgets.fk_id_tramite` was removed
The column is nullable. Deleting the workflow
Payments cannot exist without a budget.
Do not delete a budget that has payments.
V14: the redundant foreign key on budgets was removed.
The procedure starts without a deed.
The deed is assigned when the act is granted.
Folios that are available, or stored as "Errose / No Pasó",
Copies that were not picked up,
or that were issued by mistake, are deleted.
